Production pixel-art SPRITE SHEET, one sheet of EXACTLY 8 separate full-body poses in a uniform 4-column by 2-row grid, canvas landscape 1536x1024, each cell 384x512. Reference image establishes the existing enemy identity: bony skeleton warrior with bare skull, ragged red scarf, steel sword and round wooden shield. Retain its colors, equipment and face silhouette, with detailed clean pixel art consistent with the game. Each pose faces LEFT in three-quarter side view. Bottom row four consecutive ATTACK poses: 1 raises sword to prepare, 2 winds back sword, 3 slashes LEFT while shielding, 4 follows through ready to recover. Absolutely NO crossing cell boundaries, no cropping, no labels, no grid lines. Background MUST be genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, no black backdrop, no shadows or floor. All eight frames must be visibly different and usable for animation.
